base: Using the attached photo of this exact dog as the likeness reference (keep her round fluffy head shape, long drop ears, dark eyes, button nose and happy tongue-out expression recognizable), create a minimalist logo-style artwork of her HEAD ONLY. Pure black ink on a flat pure white background, no gray fill, no color unless the style says so, no shading gradients, no texture, no shadow, no frame, no collar, no body below the neck. Generous empty margin on every side. Clean crisp vector-like edges suitable for a t-shirt print and a cap embroidery. Absolutely no text, letters, signature or watermark.

Style: loose expressive continuous line with playful loops and scribbles that describe the curly cloud fur, slightly imperfect hand-drawn energy, front-facing.

Style: single continuous elegant line drawing in three-quarter profile looking up, flowing line that trails off downward like a ribbon, very minimal.
